```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(bigrquery)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)

# BigQuery connection
project_id <- "wmt-instockinventory-datamart"
billing_project <- "wmt-instockinventory-datamart"

# Authenticate (uses ADC on Posit Connect)
bq_auth(path = Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"))

con <- dbConnect(
  bigrquery::bigquery(),
  project = project_id,
  billing = billing_project
)

# Hidden SBUs (low volume - filtered out)
HIDDEN_SBUS <- c("OTHER", "UNASSIGNED")

# Query the rollup data with all channels including DC Type breakdown
query <- "
SELECT
  BUS_DT,
  MDS_FAM_ID,
  ITEM_NBR AS WALMART_NBR,
  REPL_GROUP_NBR,
  OMNI_SEG_DESC AS SBU,
  OMNI_DIVISION,
  OMNI_DEPT_NBR,
  OMNI_DEPT_DESC,
  OMNI_CATG_NBR,
  OMNI_CATG_DESC AS CATEGORY,
  REPLEN_TYPE,
  UNIT_COST,
  -- Store Network
  STORE_OH_UNITS,
  COALESCE(ON_FLOOR_UNITS, 0) AS ON_FLOOR_UNITS,
  COALESCE(BACKROOM_UNITS, 0) AS BACKROOM_UNITS,
  COALESCE(DC_RESERVED_UNITS, 0) AS DC_RESERVED_UNITS,
  IN_TRANSIT_UNITS,
  -- DC Network (Total)
  DC_OH_UNITS,
  COALESCE(DC_LABELED_UNITS, 0) AS DC_LABELED_UNITS,
  COALESCE(DC_UNLABELED_UNITS, 0) AS DC_UNLABELED_UNITS,
  -- DC Type Breakdown
  COALESCE(DC_OH_REGIONAL_UNITS, 0) AS DC_OH_REGIONAL,
  COALESCE(DC_OH_GROCERY_UNITS, 0) AS DC_OH_GROCERY,
  COALESCE(DC_OH_FASHION_UNITS, 0) AS DC_OH_FASHION,
  COALESCE(DC_OH_IMPORTS_UNITS, 0) AS DC_OH_IMPORTS,
  -- Additional Channels
  COALESCE(STO_IN_TRANSIT_TO_DC_UNITS, 0) AS STO_UNITS,
  COALESCE(FC_OH_UNITS, 0) AS FC_OH_UNITS,
  COALESCE(ON_YARD_UNITS, 0) AS ON_YARD_UNITS,
  -- Totals
  COALESCE(TOTAL_NETWORK_UNITS, 0) AS TOTAL_NETWORK_UNITS,
  -- Costs
  COALESCE(STORE_OH_COST, 0) AS STORE_OH_COST,
  COALESCE(DC_OH_COST, 0) AS DC_OH_COST,
  COALESCE(IN_TRANSIT_COST, 0) AS IN_TRANSIT_COST,
  COALESCE(TOTAL_NETWORK_COST, 0) AS TOTAL_NETWORK_COST
FROM `wmt-instockinventory-datamart.WM_AD_HOC.WHERES_MY_STUFF_ROLLUP`
"

rollup_data <- dbGetQuery(con, query)

# Filter out hidden SBUs
rollup_data <- rollup_data %>% filter(!SBU %in% HIDDEN_SBUS)

# Get unique values for filters
sbus <- sort(unique(rollup_data$SBU))
departments <- sort(unique(rollup_data$OMNI_DEPT_DESC))
categories <- sort(unique(rollup_data$CATEGORY[!is.na(rollup_data$CATEGORY)]))
divisions <- sort(unique(rollup_data$OMNI_DIVISION))
dc_types <- c("Regional (RDC)", "Grocery (GDC)", "Fashion (FDC)", "Imports")

# Format helpers
format_units <- function(x) {
  if (x >= 1e9) return(paste0(round(x / 1e9, 2), "B"))
  if (x >= 1e6) return(paste0(round(x / 1e6, 1), "M"))
  if (x >= 1e3) return(paste0(round(x / 1e3, 1), "K"))
  return(format(round(x), big.mark = ","))
}

format_cost <- function(x) {
  if (x >= 1e9) return(paste0("$", round(x / 1e9, 2), "B"))
  if (x >= 1e6) return(paste0("$", round(x / 1e6, 1), "M"))
  return(paste0("$", format(round(x), big.mark = ",")))
}
```

# Filters

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput(
 "sbu_filter",
 "SBU (Division):",
 choices = c("All SBUs" = "", sbus),
 selected = "",
 multiple = TRUE
)

selectInput(
 "dept_filter",
 "Department:",
 choices = c("All Departments" = "", departments),
 selected = "",
 multiple = TRUE
)

selectInput(
 "catg_filter",
 "Category:",
 choices = c("All Categories" = "", categories),
 selected = "",
 multiple = TRUE
)

selectInput(
 "dc_type_filter",
 "DC Type:",
 choices = c("All DC Types" = "", dc_types),
 selected = "",
 multiple = TRUE
)

selectInput(
 "replen_filter",
 "Replen Type:",
 choices = c("All" = "", "REPLEN", "NON-REPLEN"),
 selected = ""
)

textInput(
 "item_filter",
 "Item Search (MDS_FAM_ID, Item#, CID):",
 value = ""
)

hr()

actionButton("reset_btn", "Reset Filters", class = "btn-outline-secondary btn-sm")

hr()

p(tags$small(em(paste("Data Date:", max(rollup_data$BUS_DT, na.rm = TRUE)))))
```

```{r}
#| context: server

# Reset filters
observeEvent(input$reset_btn, {
 updateSelectInput(session, "sbu_filter", selected = "")
 updateSelectInput(session, "dept_filter", selected = "")
 updateSelectInput(session, "catg_filter", selected = "")
 updateSelectInput(session, "dc_type_filter", selected = "")
 updateSelectInput(session, "replen_filter", selected = "")
 updateTextInput(session, "item_filter", value = "")
})

# Reactive filtered data
filtered_data <- reactive({
 data <- rollup_data

 # Apply SBU filter
 if (!is.null(input$sbu_filter) && length(input$sbu_filter) > 0 && input$sbu_filter[1] != "") {
   data <- data %>% filter(SBU %in% input$sbu_filter)
 }

 # Apply Department filter
 if (!is.null(input$dept_filter) && length(input$dept_filter) > 0 && input$dept_filter[1] != "") {
   data <- data %>% filter(OMNI_DEPT_DESC %in% input$dept_filter)
 }

 # Apply Category filter
 if (!is.null(input$catg_filter) && length(input$catg_filter) > 0 && input$catg_filter[1] != "") {
   data <- data %>% filter(CATEGORY %in% input$catg_filter)
 }

 # Apply Replen filter
 if (!is.null(input$replen_filter) && input$replen_filter != "") {
   data <- data %>% filter(REPLEN_TYPE == input$replen_filter)
 }

 # Apply Item filter
 if (!is.null(input$item_filter) && input$item_filter != "") {
   item_search <- input$item_filter
   data <- data %>%
     filter(
       grepl(item_search, as.character(MDS_FAM_ID), ignore.case = TRUE) |
       grepl(item_search, as.character(WALMART_NBR), ignore.case = TRUE) |
       grepl(item_search, as.character(REPL_GROUP_NBR), ignore.case = TRUE)
     )
 }

 data
})

# Get selected DC types for filtering DC values
selected_dc_types <- reactive({
 if (is.null(input$dc_type_filter) || length(input$dc_type_filter) == 0 || input$dc_type_filter[1] == "") {
   return(c("Regional", "Grocery", "Fashion", "Imports"))
 }
 types <- c()
 if ("Regional (RDC)" %in% input$dc_type_filter) types <- c(types, "Regional")
 if ("Grocery (GDC)" %in% input$dc_type_filter) types <- c(types, "Grocery")
 if ("Fashion (FDC)" %in% input$dc_type_filter) types <- c(types, "Fashion")
 if ("Imports" %in% input$dc_type_filter) types <- c(types, "Imports")
 return(types)
})

# Summary metrics with DC Type filtering
summary_metrics <- reactive({
 data <- filtered_data()
 dc_types <- selected_dc_types()

 # Calculate DC units based on selected DC types
 dc_oh <- 0
 if ("Regional" %in% dc_types) dc_oh <- dc_oh + sum(data$DC_OH_REGIONAL, na.rm = TRUE)
 if ("Grocery" %in% dc_types) dc_oh <- dc_oh + sum(data$DC_OH_GROCERY, na.rm = TRUE)
 if ("Fashion" %in% dc_types) dc_oh <- dc_oh + sum(data$DC_OH_FASHION, na.rm = TRUE)
 if ("Imports" %in% dc_types) dc_oh <- dc_oh + sum(data$DC_OH_IMPORTS, na.rm = TRUE)

 # If DC type filter is applied, zero out store metrics
 dc_type_filtered <- length(dc_types) < 4

 list(
   total_items = n_distinct(data$MDS_FAM_ID),
   # Store Network (zeroed if DC type filter active)
   on_floor_units = if (dc_type_filtered) 0 else sum(data$ON_FLOOR_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   backroom_units = if (dc_type_filtered) 0 else sum(data$BACKROOM_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   store_units = if (dc_type_filtered) 0 else sum(data$STORE_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   dc_reserved_units = if (dc_type_filtered) 0 else sum(data$DC_RESERVED_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   transit_units = if (dc_type_filtered) 0 else sum(data$IN_TRANSIT_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   # DC Network (filtered by DC type)
   dc_units = dc_oh,
   dc_oh_regional = sum(data$DC_OH_REGIONAL, na.rm = TRUE),
   dc_oh_grocery = sum(data$DC_OH_GROCERY, na.rm = TRUE),
   dc_oh_fashion = sum(data$DC_OH_FASHION, na.rm = TRUE),
   dc_oh_imports = sum(data$DC_OH_IMPORTS, na.rm = TRUE),
   dc_labeled_units = sum(data$DC_LABELED_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   dc_unlabeled_units = sum(data$DC_UNLABELED_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   # Additional Channels
   sto_units = sum(data$STO_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   fc_units = if (dc_type_filtered) 0 else sum(data$FC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   on_yard_units = sum(data$ON_YARD_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   # Total Network
   total_units = sum(data$TOTAL_NETWORK_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
   # Costs
   store_cost = sum(data$STORE_OH_COST, na.rm = TRUE),
   dc_cost = sum(data$DC_OH_COST, na.rm = TRUE),
   transit_cost = sum(data$IN_TRANSIT_COST, na.rm = TRUE),
   total_cost = sum(data$TOTAL_NETWORK_COST, na.rm = TRUE)
 )
})
```

## Row {height=64%}

### Column {width=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "Inventory by SBU"

renderPlotly({
 data <- filtered_data() %>%
   group_by(SBU) %>%
   summarise(
     On_Floor = sum(ON_FLOOR_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     Backroom = sum(BACKROOM_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     DC_OH = sum(DC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     In_Transit = sum(IN_TRANSIT_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     DC_Reserved = sum(DC_RESERVED_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     DC_Labeled = sum(DC_LABELED_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     DC_Unlabeled = sum(DC_UNLABELED_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     STO = sum(STO_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     FC = sum(FC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     On_Yard = sum(ON_YARD_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     Total = sum(TOTAL_NETWORK_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     .groups = "drop"
   ) %>%
   arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
   head(10) %>%
   pivot_longer(cols = c(On_Floor, Backroom, DC_OH, In_Transit, DC_Reserved,
                         DC_Labeled, DC_Unlabeled, STO, FC, On_Yard),
                names_to = "Channel", values_to = "Units")

 # Channel colors matching HTML dashboard
 channel_colors <- c(
   "On_Floor" = "#40916c", "Backroom" = "#c49a09", "DC_OH" = "#007bff",
   "In_Transit" = "#e67300", "DC_Reserved" = "#7c3aed", "DC_Labeled" = "#e91e8c",
   "DC_Unlabeled" = "#8e44ad", "STO" = "#17a589", "FC" = "#6d28d9", "On_Yard" = "#dc2626"
 )

 # Order channels
 data$Channel <- factor(data$Channel, levels = names(channel_colors))

 p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Units / 1e6, y = reorder(SBU, Units), fill = Channel)) +
   geom_col(position = "stack") +
   scale_fill_manual(values = channel_colors) +
   labs(x = "Units (M)", y = "") +
   theme_minimal() +
   theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())

 ggplotly(p) %>% layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
})
```

```{r}
#| title: "Channel Mix (%)"

renderPlotly({
 metrics <- summary_metrics()

 total <- metrics$on_floor_units + metrics$backroom_units + metrics$dc_units +
          metrics$transit_units + metrics$dc_reserved_units + metrics$dc_labeled_units +
          metrics$dc_unlabeled_units + metrics$sto_units + metrics$fc_units + metrics$on_yard_units

 if (total == 0) total <- 1  # Avoid division by zero

 df <- data.frame(
   Channel = c("On Floor", "Backroom", "DC OH", "In-Transit", "DC Reserved",
               "DC Labeled", "DC Unlabeled", "STO", "FC", "On Yard"),
   Units = c(metrics$on_floor_units, metrics$backroom_units, metrics$dc_units,
             metrics$transit_units, metrics$dc_reserved_units, metrics$dc_labeled_units,
             metrics$dc_unlabeled_units, metrics$sto_units, metrics$fc_units, metrics$on_yard_units),
   Pct = c(metrics$on_floor_units, metrics$backroom_units, metrics$dc_units,
           metrics$transit_units, metrics$dc_reserved_units, metrics$dc_labeled_units,
           metrics$dc_unlabeled_units, metrics$sto_units, metrics$fc_units, metrics$on_yard_units) / total * 100
 )

 channel_colors <- c(
   "On Floor" = "#40916c", "Backroom" = "#c49a09", "DC OH" = "#007bff",
   "In-Transit" = "#e67300", "DC Reserved" = "#7c3aed", "DC Labeled" = "#e91e8c",
   "DC Unlabeled" = "#8e44ad", "STO" = "#17a589", "FC" = "#6d28d9", "On Yard" = "#dc2626"
 )

 df$Channel <- factor(df$Channel, levels = names(channel_colors))

 p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 1, y = Pct, fill = Channel)) +
   geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.5) +
   coord_flip() +
   scale_fill_manual(values = channel_colors) +
   labs(x = "", y = "Percentage (%)") +
   theme_minimal() +
   theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
         legend.position = "bottom")

 ggplotly(p) %>% layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
})
```

```{r}
renderPlotly({
 metrics <- summary_metrics()

 df <- data.frame(
   Component = c("DC On-Hand", "DC Labeled", "DC Unlabeled", "STO to DC", "On Yard"),
   Units = c(metrics$dc_units, metrics$dc_labeled_units, metrics$dc_unlabeled_units,
             metrics$sto_units, metrics$on_yard_units)
 )

 comp_colors <- c("DC On-Hand" = "#007bff", "DC Labeled" = "#e91e8c",
                  "DC Unlabeled" = "#8e44ad", "STO to DC" = "#17a589", "On Yard" = "#dc2626")

 p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(Component, -Units), y = Units / 1e6, fill = Component)) +
   geom_col() +
   scale_fill_manual(values = comp_colors) +
   labs(x = "", y = "Units (M)") +
   theme_minimal() +
   theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

 ggplotly(p)
})
```

# Data Table

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Full Data Export (SBU > Department)"

renderDT({
 data <- filtered_data() %>%
   group_by(SBU, OMNI_DEPT_DESC, OMNI_DEPT_NBR) %>%
   summarise(
     On_Floor = sum(ON_FLOOR_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     Backroom = sum(BACKROOM_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     Store_OH = sum(STORE_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     DC_OH = sum(DC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     In_Transit = sum(IN_TRANSIT_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     DC_Reserved = sum(DC_RESERVED_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     DC_Labeled = sum(DC_LABELED_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     DC_Unlabeled = sum(DC_UNLABELED_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     STO = sum(STO_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     FC = sum(FC_OH_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     On_Yard = sum(ON_YARD_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     Total = sum(TOTAL_NETWORK_UNITS, na.rm = TRUE),
     Cost = sum(TOTAL_NETWORK_COST, na.rm = TRUE),
     .groups = "drop"
   ) %>%
   rename(Department = OMNI_DEPT_DESC, Dept_Nbr = OMNI_DEPT_NBR) %>%
   arrange(SBU, desc(Total))

 datatable(
   data,
   filter = "top",
   options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE, dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel')),
   extensions = 'Buttons'
 ) %>%
   formatRound(c("On_Floor", "Backroom", "Store_OH", "DC_OH", "In_Transit", "DC_Reserved",
                 "DC_Labeled", "DC_Unlabeled", "STO", "FC", "On_Yard", "Total"), digits = 0, mark = ",") %>%
   formatCurrency("Cost", currency = "$", digits = 0)
})
```
